info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Careers Applications Referrals-v2-spec
info.description: The Career Applications Referrals API enables users to access and retrieve a list of referral applications submitted for career opportunities. This endpoint is designed for recruiters and hiring managers who need to view candidate referrals and their application statuses. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their talent acquisition processes and improve collaboration among team members involved in recruitment. Typical use cases include managing and assessing referrals to enhance hiring decisions.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch a list of referral applications. It provides access to various details related to the applications submitted for referral.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve referral application details. Please ensure that the JSON structure adheres to the defined schema.

202.description: Request has been accepted and is being processed asynchronously.

ListCareersApplicationsReferralsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on referral applications.

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the referral operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the referral.

resultId.description: Identifier of the result associated with the referral process.

state.description: Current state of the referral process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Informational message detailing the outcome of the referral operation.

audit.description: Details about the creation and execution context of the referral.

ListCareersApplicationsReferralsResponse.description: Response schema for the referral operation GET request, providing the status and details of the referral process.

createdBy.description: The identifier or name of the user or system that created the referral.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the referral was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the referral was created through an automated process.

Audit.description: Schema representing audit details for the referral operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request.
